scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Hey~! Hi human~ This is Mr. Dolangmal. kakaka~
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
嘿~！你好呀人類~ 我是多朗馬爾先生。咔咔咔~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
We are sent to here to take you to the heaven of cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
我們被派到這裡，是為了帶你去貓的天堂，^A2314BMalangdo^000000。

scripts.text: [Dolangmal]
scripts.translation: [多朗馬爾]

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
How is that? The crowded city of Prontera is good, but why don't you go our heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
怎麼樣？普隆德拉雖然是個熱鬧的城市，但為什麼不去貓的天堂，^A2314BMalangdo^000000呢？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Why don't you go to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000? That place is better than Geffen, where there are only crowds of simple honest wizards.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
為什麼不去^A2314BMalangdo^000000呢？那裡比吉芬好多了，吉芬只有一群樸實無華的巫師。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
The fresh air of Payon is not bad, but why don't you go better place like the heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
斐揚的新鮮空氣雖然不錯，但為什麼不去更好的地方，比如貓的天堂，^A2314BMalangdo^000000呢？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The beautiful and quiet place is better than Aldebaran, where it's so noisy with the tick-tock sound of the clock.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
{0}那個美麗寧靜的地方，比阿爾德巴蘭好多了，那裡總是傳來古鐘魔滴答滴答的吵鬧聲。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The beautiful and quiet place is better than Morocc, with its heat and sandstorms.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
{0}那個美麗寧靜的地方，比莫洛可好多了，那裡又熱又多沙塵暴。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The beautiful place is better than Juno, which is full of books and headaches.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
{0}那個美麗的地方，比朱諾好多了，那裡全是書，讓人頭疼。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The complex place is better than Rachel, where it's too horribly quiet.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
{0}那個複雜的地方，比拉赫好多了，那裡安靜得可怕。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The safe place is better than Lighthalzen, which is too dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
{0}那個安全的地方，比裡希塔樂鎮好多了，那裡太危險了。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The smell of this sea place is better than Mora, which is full of a grassy smell.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
{0}這個海邊的味道，比穆拉好多了，那裡全是草腥味。

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: ^A2314BMalangdo^000000~ Go~ Go~
scripts.translation: ^A2314BMalangdo^000000~ 走~ 走~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
What!? You don't want to go ^A2314BMalangdo^000000? Chet!
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
什麼！？你不想去^A2314BMalangdo^000000？切！

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
You're such an annoying guy. If you don't go, why did you talk to me... but...
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
你真是個討厭的傢伙。既然不想去，幹嘛還跟我說話... 但是...

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 said to kidnap humans... No... Bring them politely?
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
^9E1837托馬船長^000000說要把人類綁架過來... 不對... 是禮貌地請他們過來？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Anyway, I got you. Whenever you want to go, just tell me.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
總之，我已經把你拿下了。想走的時候，隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Ok! I like your attitude. Full of passion.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
好！我喜歡你的態度。充滿熱情。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Now, before you go ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, let me give you some warnings.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
現在，在你去^A2314BMalangdo^000000之前，讓我給你一些警告。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
First!! It is natural that when you arrive on ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, you should notify ^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 that you are here.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
首先！！當你到達^A2314BMalangdo^000000時，你應該通知^9E1837托馬船長^000000你來了。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
If you don't do that, you might be attacked by scary and wild cats when you walk through dark streets.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
如果不這樣做，你在穿過黑暗的街道時，可能會被可怕且野性的貓襲擊。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Secondly!! This ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 is absolutely our island of cats, even though we open to humans.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
其次！！雖然我們對人類開放，但^A2314BMalangdo^000000絕對是我們的貓島。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
We have a personality... no... no... respect us like one catality because we are cats.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
我們要保持個性...不...不...要像對待貓一樣尊重我們，因為我們是貓。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
And the next one is...
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
下一條是...

scripts.text: Dolangmal proceeds and gives hundreds of warnings.
scripts.translation: 多朗馬爾繼續說，給出了數百條警告。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Ok! Those are all the warnings!! They're easy and simple... right? Can you remember them?
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
好了！這些就是所有的警告！！很簡單吧...對吧？你能記住嗎？

scripts.text: Remember his warnings
scripts.translation: 記住他的警告

scripts.text: Can't remember
scripts.translation: 記不住

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Ok! Do not bite two mice with one mouth. ^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 is located at the ^A2314Bcenter of the ship in Malangdo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
好的！不要貪多嚼不爛。^9E1837托馬船長^000000位於^A2314BMalangdo的船中心^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Don't forget to give him notice of your arrival.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
別忘了通知他你到了。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Alright. Let's go to the heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000~
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
好了。讓我們去貓的天堂，^A2314BMalangdo^000000~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
What!? Can't you keep these easy rules? Chet!
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
什麼！？這些簡單的規則你都記不住嗎？切！

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
You're such an annoying guy. If you can't keep these, why didn't you tell me during our conversation? I told you everything... but..
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
你真是個討厭的傢伙。如果你記不住這些，為什麼不在我們談話時告訴我？我都告訴你了...但是..

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 said to kidnap humans... No... Bring them politely?
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
^9E1837托馬船長^000000說要把人類綁架過來... 不對... 是禮貌地請他們過來？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Anyway, I got you. Just tell me whenever you want to go.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
總之，我已經把你拿下了。想走的時候，隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Uh? You must be the one from last time...? Alright. Did you visit ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
呃？你一定是上次那個人...？好的。你去過^A2314BMalangdo^000000嗎？

scripts.text: Take me to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 again
scripts.translation: 再帶我去一次^A2314BMalangdo^000000

scripts.text: I have visited
scripts.translation: 我去過了

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
I really want to send you there, but I can't because of the policy. It is difficult to send people who have visited ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 already.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
我真的很想送你過去，但由於政策原因，我無法這樣做。對於已經去過^A2314BMalangdo^000000的人，很難再次傳送。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
And that was roughly it... It's supposed to be rule 53...
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
大概就是這樣...這應該是規則53...

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Actually, let me tell you rule 53. I am an indulgent cat.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
實際上，讓我告訴你規則53。我是一隻寬容的貓。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
If you want to go back to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, take the ship at Izlude or Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
如果您想回到^A2314BMalangdo^000000，請乘坐依斯魯得島或艾爾貝塔的船。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
If you enjoy that pleasant sea trip, you will arrive at the heaven of cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
如果您享受這段愉快的海上旅程，您就會抵達貓的天堂，^A2314BMalangdo^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
So easy! Isn't it? Well, good bye~
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
很簡單吧？那麼，再見~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
How was it? You liked it? I knew it. Kakaka~
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
感覺如何？您喜歡嗎？我就知道。哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Ah! I just want to make sure...
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
啊！我只是想確認一下...

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Again, if you want to go back to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, do you know where to take a ship at Izlude or Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
再說一次，如果您想回到^A2314BMalangdo^000000，您知道在依斯魯得島或艾爾貝塔哪裡可以乘船嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Hm~ You might know because you're a smart person. Well, see you again~
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
嗯~ 您可能是個聰明人，所以應該知道吧。那麼，下次見~

scripts.text: This cat is sleeping in the warm {0} sun.
scripts.translation: 這隻貓正在溫暖的{0}陽光下睡覺。

scripts.text: Let him sleep
scripts.translation: 讓它睡吧

scripts.text: Talk to him
scripts.translation: 和他談談

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
Meow? Huh?
scripts.translation:
[奧德格納拉姆]
喵？嗯？

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
You are a hero of cat's fleet. Your activity is the legend between us.
scripts.translation:
[奧德格納拉姆]
您是貓艦隊的英雄。您的事蹟在我們之間是傳說。

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
As you are a hero of the cat fleet let me send you to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 for free.
scripts.translation:
[奧德格納拉姆]
既然您是貓艦隊的英雄，讓我免費送您去^A2314BMalangdo^000000吧。

scripts.text: Send me to Malangdo!
scripts.translation: 送我去Malangdo！

scripts.text: Do not go.
scripts.translation: 不去。

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
Have a comfortable trip... Alright let's go~
scripts.translation:
[奧德格納拉姆]
祝您旅途愉快... 好了，出發~

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
{0}

{0}

scripts.text: Send me to Malangdo!
scripts.translation: 送我去Malangdo！

scripts.text: Do not go.
scripts.translation: 不去。

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
Money? Where is the money? You can't go anywhere without the money. Shame on you.
scripts.translation:
[奧德格納拉姆]
錢？錢在哪裡？沒有錢您哪裡也去不了。真丟人。

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
Let me send you right away. Let's go~
scripts.translation:
[奧德格納拉姆]
讓我馬上送您過去。出發~

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Did you have fun in Malangdo?
The fleet has a service to Izlude and Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
您在Malangdo玩得開心嗎？
我們的船隊提供前往依斯魯得島和艾爾貝塔的服務。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
The fee of ship is only 1000 zeny, where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[孔]
船費只需1000 Zeny，您想去哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Kong]
You have a connection with our fleet. Apply special price 999 zeny. Where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[孔]
您與我們的船隊有聯絡。享受特價999 Zeny。您想去哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Wow~ You contributed to our fleet a lot. Alright!! Special discount price 500 zeny. Where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[孔]
哇~ 您為我們的船隊貢獻良多。好啊！！
給您特價500 Zeny。您想去哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Ah... You are the legendary hero of our cat's fleet.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
啊... 您是我們貓船隊的傳奇英雄。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
We can't charge the hero of our fleet. What is your destination?
scripts.translation:
[孔]
我們不能向船隊的英雄收費。您的目的地是哪裡？

You see a lazy cat standing on a chair.
You guess that this is the Innkeeper.

你看到一隻懶洋洋的貓站在椅子上。
你猜測這就是旅店老闆。

scripts.text: Umm... Can I rest here?
scripts.translation: 嗯... 我可以休息一下嗎？

scripts.text: Psst... Can I save here?
scripts.translation: 噓... 我可以儲存嗎？

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Eh?
Uh, sure you can use this hammock if you give me ^FF00005 Malangdo Cans^000000.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
咦？
呃，如果你給我^FF00005個馬拉恩多罐頭^000000，當然可以用這個吊床。

scripts.text: Here you go.
scripts.translation: 給您。

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Now relax.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
現在放鬆一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
This ain't no charity.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
這可不是慈善。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Let me know if you want to relax.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
如果你想放鬆，告訴我一聲。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Location saved. We should keep company, haha~
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
位置已儲存。我們要多親近親近，哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Sometimes you just have to relax.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
有時候就是得放鬆一下。

scripts.text: - Wow, this is the laziest cat ever. -
scripts.translation: - 哇，這是有史以來最懶的貓。-

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Boy, that lazy cat makes me want to just nap all day long.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師]
男孩，那隻懶貓讓我只想整天睡覺。

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
He makes life look so simple.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師]
它讓生活看起來如此簡單。

scripts.text:
[Wanderer]
The cats living in here are so energetic.
Is it weird that they make me want to dance all day?
La di dah di dah~!
scripts.translation:
[浪姬舞者]
這裡的貓都精力充沛。
它們讓我想整天跳舞，這很奇怪嗎？
啦啦啦~！

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
Ooo~ their soft puffy tails and soft fur~
I can't stand it, this is heaven~~!!
scripts.translation:
[馴貓師]
噢~它們毛茸茸的尾巴和柔軟的皮毛~
受不了了，這裡簡直是天堂~~！！

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
My hidden card, ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000, can make all cats in Malangdo my slaves~ haha!
scripts.translation:
[馴貓師]
我的王牌出手，^FF0000獼猴桃果實^000000，能讓瑪朗多所有的貓都成為我的奴隸~哈哈！

scripts.text: ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000?

scripts.translation:
[馴貓師]
那是非常稀有的物品！
我很難弄到。
但這些可愛的貓對它毫無抵抗力~

scripts.text: Where can I get ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000?
scripts.translation: 哪裡可以買到^FF0000獼猴桃果實^000000？

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
Why would I tell you when I can barely get it?
I wouldn't even tell you for all the zeny in the world~!
scripts.translation:
[馴貓師]
我本來就很難弄到，為什麼要告訴你？
就算給我全世界的Zeny我也不會說~！

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
All the Malangdo cats are mine~!
Muahahahaha~

scripts.translation:

瑪朗多所有的貓都是我的~！
嘿嘿嘿嘿~
只要有足夠的^FF0000獼猴桃果實^000000，我就能成為瑪朗多的女王~噢噢噢！！！

嗯，看來你不知道也不奇怪。
這些瑪朗多的貓對它毫無抵抗力。

[Cat Trainer]
Actually, it's simple. You just...

[馴貓師]
其實很簡單。你只要...

scripts.translation:
[馴貓師]
嘿，你差點讓我把秘密說漏嘴了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
One day these cats will be mine.
I can be a king in Malangdo~ ohhh~!
scripts.translation:

總有一天這些貓都會是我的。
我就能成為瑪朗多的國王~噢噢~！
